title: Twenty product-feed concepts: source, destination, and review
scope: Selected Google product-data fields, Shopify Admin API 2026-07 source locations, and OpenAI Stable native discovery file uploads. Not a complete feed, upload validator, or admission guarantee. Google-compatible OpenAI uploads are a separate path.

sources.title: OpenAI: Stable product file-upload specification
sources.note: Native discovery fields and the distinct Google-compatible path. This edition is a selected comparison, not the complete upload contract.

sources.title: Google Merchant Center: Product data specification
sources.note: Google feed field names and category-dependent requirements. This reference does not cover every country, category, or program.

sources.title: Shopify Admin API 2026-07: Product
sources.note: Source product description, vendor, category, and online-store URL. Suggested transformations remain editorial decisions.

sources.title: Shopify Admin API 2026-07: ProductVariant
sources.note: Variant identity, SKU, barcode, selected options, media, inventory, and pricing context. A source field does not prove destination eligibility.

sources.title: Shopify: Versioned product taxonomy and mappings
sources.note: Existing category and attribute mappings. Record a pinned release and examine the actual mapping rather than equating category IDs.

sources.title: Google Merchant Center: Product ID
sources.note: Stable distinct product identifiers, including separate variant IDs.

sources.title: Google Merchant Center: Item group ID
sources.note: Variant groups, identifying attributes, and matching landing-page values.

sources.title: Google Merchant Center: Price
sources.note: Amount and currency, plus agreement with landing page and checkout.

sources.title: Google Merchant Center: Availability
sources.note: Google stock-state vocabulary and matching availability across shopping surfaces.

sources.title: Google Merchant Center: Product dimensions and weight
sources.note: Product measures, accepted units, and agreement between repeated measurements. Packaging has a different meaning.

fields.name: Item identity
fields.shopifySource: Variant ID or verified unique SKU
fields.decision: Use an immutable string for the sellable selection. Check uniqueness before choosing a SKU as the identifier; a parent record cannot identify every child.
fields.review: Numeric conversion may erase leading zeros; do not reconstruct a lost identifier by guessing.

fields.name: Title
fields.shopifySource: Product title + selected options
fields.decision: Name the selection the visitor will receive. Assemble the title from supported facts and inspect the result after truncation.
fields.review: A syntactically valid title can identify the wrong color. Compare it with the actual selected variant.

fields.name: Description
fields.shopifySource: descriptionHtml or reviewed plain description
fields.decision: Convert markup to readable text while retaining meaningful separations. Check claims against source facts instead of letting a cleanup step add benefits.

illustrativeCandidate.description: Blue ceramic mug with a handle.

fields.review: A claim without supporting evidence needs review even when it fits the destination field.

fields.name: Product URL
fields.shopifySource: onlineStoreUrl + verified variant selection
fields.decision: Check the page in the intended market and selected option. A public parent URL is insufficient evidence that the correct item is selected.
fields.review: The URL can resolve successfully while landing on the wrong offer.

fields.name: Main image
fields.shopifySource: Variant-associated media
fields.decision: Choose an image tied to the selection, then confirm the depicted finish and size where visible. Keep image identity separate from URL syntax.
fields.review: Image review needs the asset itself. A filename is only a clue, not visual proof.

fields.name: Brand
fields.shopifySource: Verified brand; inspect product.vendor
fields.decision: Confirm that the source vendor value is actually the product brand. In a reseller catalog, seller and brand can be different organizations.
fields.review: Resolve the brand from approved product evidence; an invented placeholder is not a repair.

fields.name: Seller
fields.shopifySource: Verified seller identity for this offer
fields.googleField: Merchant/account context; no equivalent generic field assumed
fields.decision: Attach the organization selling this offer. A Google-style row alone may not carry the seller information needed by a different integration.
fields.review: Require an explicit trusted source for seller identity. Do not copy brand merely because a required cell is empty.

fields.name: Regular price
fields.shopifySource: Variant price with market and currency context
fields.decision: Keep amount, currency, market, and extraction time together. Compare the payable amount with page evidence for the same selection.
fields.review: Both strings can parse. Only evidence establishes whether a cents-to-major-unit conversion was appropriate.

fields.name: Availability
fields.shopifySource: Sellability evidence plus inventory policy
fields.decision: Use an explicit vocabulary mapping. Google preorder and native pre_order differ. A quantity alone does not resolve release status, sales-channel eligibility, or backorder policy.
fields.review: The second spelling belongs to the Google vocabulary; choose the destination path before translating. Unknown stock must not become an in-stock claim.

fields.name: Parent group
fields.shopifySource: Product/parent identity for verified sibling variants
fields.decision: Preserve a parent identifier separately from each sellable item. Group only genuine selections of the same product.
fields.review: A repeated parent/child identifier cannot express which selection is being offered.

fields.name: Selected options
fields.shopifySource: selectedOptions name/value pairs
fields.decision: Keep the selected values as a map. Validate duplicate option names before building an object, because overwriting a key can conceal conflicting input.
fields.review: Top-level attributes and selected options must agree. A transform should expose this contradiction, not silently choose a winner.

fields.name: GTIN / barcode
fields.shopifySource: barcode, only after identifying its standard
fields.nativeScope: Native optional; Google requirements depend on the product
fields.decision: Keep assigned identifiers as strings. Check length and check digit, then verify assignment to the exact trade item. A checksum alone does not prove ownership or authenticity.
fields.review: These are deliberately unassigned synthetic checksum examples. The first has a valid checksum but is not a publishable real GTIN; the second fails the checksum.

fields.name: Manufacturer part number
fields.shopifySource: Manufacturer-controlled field or metafield
fields.nativeScope: Native optional; Google requirements depend on the product
fields.decision: Keep the manufacturer identifier separate from an internal SKU. Preserve its original spelling and punctuation with the associated brand.
fields.review: A missing GTIN does not authorize inventing a manufacturer identifier.

fields.name: Category
fields.shopifySource: Product category from a pinned taxonomy release
fields.decision: Treat taxonomy mapping as its own transformation. Record both source and destination taxonomy versions and inspect ambiguous or unmapped categories.
fields.review: This editorial path is illustrative. A source-specific category ID is not automatically a destination category path.

fields.name: Color
fields.shopifySource: Selected option or verified category metafield
fields.decision: Normalize presentation only when meaning is preserved. Do not merge distinct finishes because their labels contain the same color word.
fields.review: Retain both observed values and resolve their authority before publishing.

fields.name: Size
fields.shopifySource: Selected option plus explicit sizing context
fields.decision: Preserve the selected label and its sizing context. A numeric size is not a measured product dimension.
fields.review: Do not derive physical dimensions from a marketing size label. Use measured evidence.

fields.name: Material
fields.shopifySource: Verified product fact or category metafield
fields.decision: Distinguish a finish or appearance from the underlying material. Retain manufacturer wording when a stronger interpretation would add an unsupported claim.

counterexample.material: Solid brass because the finish is brass-colored

fields.review: Appearance is not evidence of composition.

fields.name: Product dimensions
fields.shopifySource: Verified specification fields with basis and units
fields.nativeScope: Native optional; dependencies apply when supplied
fields.decision: Store axes, units, and whether the measurement describes the item or its package. The native structured object uses at least two positive axes with one unit.
fields.review: No unit can be inferred from country, category, or a neighboring row. Packaging measures cannot establish product fit.

fields.name: Product weight
fields.shopifySource: Verified net product measure; inspect fulfillment-weight basis
fields.nativeScope: Native optional; unit required when supplied
fields.decision: Separate net product weight from packed shipping weight. Record the basis before reusing an inventory or fulfillment field.
fields.review: A bare number has no usable physical meaning. Supply the evidenced unit and basis.

fields.name: Sale price
fields.shopifySource: Reviewed current promotion; inspect compare-at semantics
fields.nativeScope: Optional; relationship and currency rules apply
fields.decision: Identify the actual current regular and sale amounts. A compare-at value is not automatically the appropriate destination regular price.
fields.review: Check the relationship, currency, and current payable amount before applying a promotion.
